paper.title: Cardiac mitochondrial function depends on BUD23 mediated ribosome programming.
paper.authors: Baxter M, Voronkov M, Poolman T, Galli G, Pinali C, Goosey L, Knight A, Krakowiak K, Maidstone R, Iqbal M, Zi M, Prehar S, Cartwright EJ, Gibbs J, Matthews LC, Adamson AD, Humphreys NE, Rebelo-Guiomar P, Minczuk M, Bechtold DA, Loudon A, Ray D.
paper.summary: Efficient mitochondrial function is required in tissues with high energy demand such as the heart, and mitochondrial dysfunction is associated with cardiovascular disease. Expression of mitochondrial proteins is tightly regulated in response to internal and external stimuli. Here we identify a novel mechanism regulating mitochondrial content and function, through BUD23-dependent ribosome generation.
paper.summary_es: Estudia cómo BUD23, mediante la generación de ribosomas, regula el contenido y la función mitocondrial. BUD23 es necesario para la maduración ribosomal y la estequiometría 18S/28S, y promueve la traducción de transcritos con 5'UTR de bajo contenido en GC. Su deleción en cardiomiocitos murinos provocó cardiomiopatía y muerte, mostrando su papel esencial en la bioenergética cardiaca posnatal.

paper.title: Control of alveolar differentiation by the lineage transcription factors GATA6 and HOPX inhibits lung adenocarcinoma metastasis.
paper.authors: Cheung WK, Zhao M, Liu Z, Stevens LE, Cao PD, Fang JE, Westbrook TF, Nguyen DX.
paper.summary: Molecular programs that mediate normal cell differentiation are required for oncogenesis and tumor cell survival in certain cancers. How cell-lineage-restricted genes specifically influence metastasis is poorly defined.

Estos factores limitan cooperativamente la competencia metastásica modulando genes de diferenciación alveolar e invasión.

paper.title: Nerve growth factor receptor negates the tumor suppressor p53 as a feedback regulator.
paper.authors: Zhou X, Hao Q, Liao P, Luo S, Zhang M, Hu G, Liu H, Zhang Y, Cao B, Baddoo M, Flemington EK, Zeng SX, Lu H.
paper.summary: Cancer develops and progresses often by inactivating p53. Here, we unveil nerve growth factor receptor (NGFR, p75NTR or CD271) as a novel p53 inactivator. p53 activates NGFR transcription, whereas NGFR inactivates p53 by promoting its MDM2-mediated ubiquitin-dependent proteolysis and by directly binding to its central DNA binding domain and preventing its DNA-binding activity.

paper.title: Loss of H2B monoubiquitination is associated with poor-differentiation and enhanced malignancy of lung adenocarcinoma.
paper.authors: Zhang K, Wang J, Tong TR, Wu X, Nelson R, Yuan YC, Reno T, Liu Z, Yun X, Kim JY, Salgia R, Raz DJ.
paper.summary: Deregulated monoubiquitination of histone H2B (H2Bub1), mainly catalyzed by E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase RNF20/RNF40 complex, may play an important role in cancer. Here we investigate potential roles of H2Bub1 and the underlying mechanisms through which it contributes to cancer development and progression in lung adenocarcinoma. We show that downregulation of H2Bub1 through RNF20 knockdown dramatically decreases H3K79 and H3K4 trimethylation in both normal and malignant lung epithelial cell lines.
paper.summary_es: Investiga el papel de la monoubiquitinación de H2B (H2Bub1) en el adenocarcinoma de pulmón. La reducción de H2Bub1 mediante knockdown de RNF20 disminuyó la trimetilación de H3K79 y H3K4, alteró genes tumorales y aumentó proliferación, migración, invasión y resistencia a cisplatino. En 170 muestras, la pérdida de H2Bub1 se asoció con mala diferenciación y tendencia a menor supervivencia.

paper.title: Chemical Proteomics Identifies Druggable Vulnerabilities in a Genetically Defined Cancer.
paper.authors: Bar-Peled L, Kemper EK, Suciu RM, Vinogradova EV, Backus KM, Horning BD, Paul TA, Ichu TA, Svensson RU, Olucha J, Chang MW, Kok BP, Zhu Z, Ihle NT, Dix MM, Jiang P, Hayward MM, Saez E, Shaw RJ, Cravatt BF.
